sculpt: Catalyst Games 2021 Inner Sphere Striker Lance Jenner / CAT35729 / base 63
method: Rebuild entire thigh and forward knee housings BEFORE deciding joint cutting planes and rig pivots; don't reject good geometry solely for disconnects; never auto-fill a hidden bridge.

mechanical_rebuild.thigh_sections: 3 to 4 loft sections, +1 real supported anterior knee-knuckle loft per side
mechanical_rebuild.shape_policy: Prefer real angled mating surfaces and revised pivots over removing sculpt improvements to satisfy previous partition geometry. No overlaps or extra hidden material.

photo_fit.method: Approximate 58-pixel manually traced 2021 plastic photos; freeze rigid camera on v15, refit both leg poses from knee/ankle/foot landmarks only because physical shin pivots moved; do not optimize silhouette or independently change camera.
excluded_views: oblique unpainted side with hidden leg and ~0.114 rigid residual
photo_fit.caveat: Not a measured sculpt accuracy percentage. Approximate photos and unknown lens parameters can change small relative rankings. Independent shape and visual human review still required.

validation.python_regression: Committed, not executed in current sandbox

next_steps: Review actual rig articulation in Godot, higher quality calibrated side/top photo landmarks; refine hip/knee mass shape with per-part masks before production promotion.
